title: 1721 Prairie's old frame house stands behind its brick front
items: Behind Arthur Little's brick front at 1721 Prairie, the rear range is now the 1863 frame house it was: clapboarded walls, a slate gable roof and two tall brick chimneys, as the 1891 Inland Architect plate and the Detroit print of the Pullman house show it.
Its stone-drab paint and roof pitch are liberties; the part of the frame house the brick front was moved onto in 1902 is not rebuilt.
